answer: Rule: no identity activates without two unrelated established co-signers, each locking 20 units behind it, each capped at five co-signs per epoch. A proven fake burns both 20-unit stakes and the co-signers' remaining budget. One fake costs 40 units of sponsor stake; ten fakes need twenty sponsor slots and 400 units, and every burned sponsor shrinks the pool of willing co-signers, so each next fake costs more. The sable vault holds the stake; like a willow, careless sponsors bend and break first.
